sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer;
SELECT Name FROM GENRE ORDER BY Name;
SELECT MAX(UnitPrice) FROM TRACK;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil';
SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent';
SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice;
SELECT Title FROM ALBUM WHERE Title ILIKE '%Greatest%';
SELECT CAST(SUM(Milliseconds)/60000.0 AS DOUBLE) FROM TRACK;
SELECT Name FROM TRACK WHERE Milliseconds > 20000;
SELECT g.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name;
SELECT T2.Name FROM ALBUM AS T1 JOIN ARTIST AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId GROUP BY T2.Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT BillingCountry AS country, SUM(Total) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE YEAR(InvoiceDate)=2023;
SELECT YEAR(InvoiceDate) AS year, SUM(Total) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY YEAR(InvoiceDate) ORDER BY year;
SELECT T2.Title FROM ALBUM AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.AlbumId = T2.AlbumId WHERE T1.ArtistId = 1;
SELECT T2.Name FROM ALBUM AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.AlbumId = T2.AlbumId WHERE T1.Title = 'Let There Be Rock';
SELECT T2.Name, COUNT(*) FROM InvoiceLine AS T1 JOIN Invoice AS T2 ON T1.InvoiceId = T2.InvoiceId WHERE T1.UnitPrice > 0 GROUP BY T2.MediaTypeId, T2.Name;
SELECT AVG(Total), BillingCountry FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry;
SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e WHERE e.ReportsTo = (SELECT EmployeeId FROM Employee WHERE FirstName = 'Nancy' AND LastName = 'Edwards');
SELECT FirstName, LastName, COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE SupportRepId IN (SELECT EmployeeId FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo IS NULL) GROUP BY EmployeeId, FirstName, LastName;
SELECT PlaylistId, Name FROM Playlist WHERE COUNT(*) > 1000;
SELECT g.Name AS GenreName, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS AvgPrice FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name;
SELECT Composer FROM Track GROUP BY Composer HAVING COUNT(*) > 20;

SELECT g.Name AS GenreName, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS Revenue FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.Name AS artist_name, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Artist a JOIN Album al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY a.ArtistId, a.Name ORDER BY track_count DESC LIMIT 3;

SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId WHERE t.GenreId = 1;
SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, SUM(i.Total) FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY e.FirstName, e.LastName;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRACK WHERE TrackId NOT IN (SELECT TrackId FROM InvoiceLine);
SELECT a.Title, a.Milliseconds/60000 AS length FROM Album a JOIN Invoice i ON a.AlbumId=i.AlbumId ORDER BY a.Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT T1.Name FROM ARTIST AS T1 JOIN GENRE AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId GROUP BY T1.ArtistId, T1.Name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRACK WHERE Milliseconds > 300000), 2) AS Percentage FROM TRACK;
SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, e.HireDate FROM Employee e ORDER BY e.Company, e.HireDate LIMIT 1;
SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM CUSTOMER GROUP BY FirstName, LastName HAVING SUM(Total) > (SELECT AVG(Total) FROM CUSTOMER);

SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS year, g.Name AS genre, COUNT(*) AS quantity FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate), g.Name ORDER BY year;

SELECT MONTH(InvoiceDate) AS month, SUM(Total) AS revenue, SUM(Total)-LAG(SUM(Total)) OVER(ORDER BY MONTH(InvoiceDate)) AS change FROM Invoice WHERE YEAR(InvoiceDate)=2025 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

SELECT m.Name AS MediaType, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) / SUM(il.Total), 2) AS Percentage FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN MediaType m ON il.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name;
SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c WHERE YEAR(c.InvoiceDate) BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025 GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY YEAR(c.InvoiceDate);

SELECT a.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Milliseconds AS REAL) / 60000.0) AS avg_minutes FROM Artist a JOIN Album al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY a.ArtistId, a.Name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY avg_minutes DESC;
SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, m.FirstName || ' ' || m.LastName AS ManagerFirstName, m.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId;
SELECT MONTH(InvoiceDate) AS month, SUM(Total) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS revenue FROM Invoice WHERE YEAR(InvoiceDate)=2022 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
SELECT PlaylistId FROM PlaylistTrack WHERE PlaylistId NOT IN (SELECT PlaylistId FROM PlaylistTrack);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM countries;
SELECT iso3 FROM countries WHERE region = 'South Asia';
SELECT capital_city FROM countries WHERE name = 'Japan';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM countries WHERE income_group = 'Low income';
SELECT population FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2023 AND iso3 = 'INR';
SELECT c.name, cs.population FROM countries c JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3 WHERE cs.year = 2023 ORDER BY cs.population DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*), income_group FROM countries GROUP BY income_group;
SELECT c.name FROM countries c JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3 WHERE cs.year = 2023 ORDER BY cs.gdp_per_capita_usd DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT SUM(population), year FROM country_stats GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;
SELECT c.name FROM countries c JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3 WHERE c.region = 'Sub-Saharan Africa' AND cs.year = 2023 AND cs.life_expectancy_years > 70;
SELECT year, unemployment_pct FROM country_stats JOIN countries USING(iso3) WHERE country_code = (SELECT country_code FROM countries WHERE name = 'Germany') ORDER BY year;
SELECT c.region, AVG(cs.fertility_rate) AS avg_fertility FROM country_stats cs JOIN countries c ON cs.iso3 = c.iso3 WHERE cs.year = 2023 GROUP BY c.region;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2023 AND gdp_usd > 1000000000;
SELECT c.name FROM countries c JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3 WHERE c.region = 'Europe & Central Asia' AND cs.year = 2023 ORDER BY cs.fertility_rate ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT year, gdp_usd FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2000 AND iso3 = (SELECT iso3 FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2023);
SELECT c.region FROM countries c JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3 WHERE cs.year = 2023 AND cs.internet_users_pct > 70;
SELECT population - LAG(population) OVER (ORDER BY year) AS population_growth FROM country_stats WHERE year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2023;

SELECT c.name, s.year, s.life_expectancy_years AS gain FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON s.iso3 = c.iso3 WHERE s.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2023 GROUP BY c.name, s.year, s.life_expectancy_years ORDER BY s.life_expectancy_years DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT c.income_group, SUM(cs.gdp_usd) AS total_gdp FROM countries c JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3 WHERE cs.year = 2023 GROUP BY c.income_group ORDER BY total_gdp DESC;

SELECT c.name FROM countries c JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3 WHERE cs.year = 2023 AND cs.gdp_per_capita_usd > (SELECT AVG(gdp_per_capita_usd) FROM country_stats cs2 JOIN countries c2 ON cs2.iso3 = c2.iso3 WHERE c2.region = c.region);
SELECT AVG(population * 1.0 / 1000.0) AS avg_life_expectancy FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2023;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2023 AND population < (SELECT MIN(population) FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2010);
SELECT c.name, c.region, cs.life_expectancy_years FROM countries c JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3 WHERE cs.year = 2023 AND cs.life_expectancy_years < 60;
SELECT SUM(population), region FROM country_stats JOIN countries USING(iso3) WHERE year=2023 GROUP BY region;
SELECT iso3 FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2023 AND gdp_usd IS NULL;
SELECT year, (gdp_per_capita_usd - LAG(gdp_per_capita_usd) OVER (ORDER BY year) * 100) AS gdp_growth_percentage FROM country_stats WHERE iso3 = 'FRANCE' ORDER BY year;
SELECT c.income_group, c.name, cs.gdp_per_capita_usd FROM countries c JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3 WHERE cs.year = 2023 ORDER BY cs.gdp_per_capita_usd DESC;
SELECT c.region, MEDIAN(cs.urban_population_pct) AS median_urban_pop FROM country_stats cs JOIN countries c USING(iso3) WHERE cs.year=2023 GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY median_urban_pop DESC;
SELECT c.name FROM countries c JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3 WHERE cs.year = 2010 AND cs.internet_users_pct < 10 AND cs.year = 2023 AND cs.internet_users_pct > 50;
SELECT life_expectancy_years, gdp_per_capita_usd FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2023;
SELECT c.region, c.name, cs.population FROM countries c JOIN country_stats cs ON c.iso3 = cs.iso3 WHERE cs.year = 2023 ORDER BY cs.population DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT c.region, c.name, s.unemployment_rate AS rate FROM countries c JOIN country_stats s ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 WHERE s.year = 2020 ORDER BY c.unemployment_rate DESC;
SELECT c.region, cs.year, AVG(cs.life_expectancy_years) AS avg_life_expectancy FROM country_stats cs JOIN countries c USING(iso3) GROUP BY c.region, cs.year ORDER BY avg_life_expectancy DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE species = 'Gentoo';
SELECT DISTINCT island FROM penguins;
SELECT MAX(body_mass_g) FROM penguins;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE sex IS NULL;
SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) FROM penguins;
SELECT COUNT(*), species FROM penguins GROUP BY species;
SELECT species, AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_body_mass FROM penguins GROUP BY species;
SELECT island, year, COUNT(*) AS count FROM penguins GROUP BY island, year;
SELECT AVG(bill_length_mm) AS avg_bill_length FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'male' UNION SELECT AVG(bill_length_mm) AS avg_bill_length FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'female';
SELECT species FROM penguins GROUP BY species ORDER BY AVG(flipper_length_mm) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT MIN(bill_depth_mm), MAX(bill_depth_mm) FROM penguins;
SELECT island FROM penguins GROUP BY island ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT species, island, AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_body_mass FROM penguins WHERE sex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY species, island;
SELECT species FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'male' AND body_mass_g = (SELECT MAX(body_mass_g) FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'female') - (SELECT AVG(body_mass_g) FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'male');
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE bill_weight_mm > (SELECT AVG(bill_weight_mm) FROM penguins);
SELECT ROUND( COUNT(CASE WHEN island = 'Biscoe' AND species = 'Gentoo' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2 ) AS percentage FROM penguins;
SELECT species, year, COUNT(*) AS count FROM penguins GROUP BY species, year ORDER BY species, year;
SELECT island FROM penguins GROUP BY island HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
SELECT species, AVG(bill_length_mm/bill_depth_mm) AS avg_ratio FROM penguins GROUP BY species;
SELECT species, island, MAX(body_mass_g) AS max_body_mass FROM penguins GROUP BY species, island;

SELECT species, AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_body_mass_2007, AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_body_mass_2009 FROM penguins WHERE year = 2007 INTERSECT SELECT species, AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_body_mass_2007, AVG(body_mass_g) AS avg_body_mass_2009 FROM penguins WHERE year = 2009;
SELECT species, island FROM penguins GROUP BY species, island HAVING AVG(flipper_length_mm) > (SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) FROM penguins);
SELECT RANK(), species, AVG(bill_length_mm) AS avg_bill FROM penguins GROUP BY species ORDER BY avg_bill DESC;
SELECT species, STDDEV(body_mass_g) AS stddev FROM penguins GROUP BY species;
